summary: Phase 4 Step 2 (Admin Package + Destination management) tested end-to-end. Backend: 26/26 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_phase4_step2_catalog.py — RBAC 401/403 on /api/admin/destinations, /api/admin/packages, /api/admin/packages/{id}/status; GET /api/admin/destinations returns all 5 seed destinations (japan, south-korea, thailand, cebu, vietnam) with package_counts (Japan shows 2 packages); GET /api/admin/packages returns 6 packages with compact shape (no embedded images/inclusions/exclusions in list view, destination summary + booking_count present); search 'osaka' hits, 'zzzzz' returns total=0, filter status=draft returns only draft packages including japan-sakura-preview. Destination CRUD: POST creates palawan-{uid}, duplicate slug returns 409, PATCH is_active=false persists & is reversible, DELETE Japan (has packages) returns 409 with proper reason. Package publish workflow: created new phuket-4d3n-{uid} draft (guest 19999, cost 17000, comm 1200, 4d3n, 2-15pax) via POST /api/admin/packages → status defaults 'draft'; publishing empty draft returns 400 'Add at least one image before publishing'; after adding image, publishing returns 400 'Add at least one inclusion before publishing'; after adding inclusion + exclusion, publish returns 200 and slug appears in GET /api/public/packages; PATCH title persists and is visible in subsequent GET; PATCH max_pax<min_pax returns 400; archiving via POST /status removes slug from GET /api/public/packages. Delete guard: DELETE bangkok-pattaya-4d3n (has BTB-DEMO-0001 booking, cancelled) returns 409 as expected — delete respects booking references regardless of booking status. Frontend (Playwright): admin login OK; sidebar shows admin-nav-packages + admin-nav-destinations (no 'Soon'); /admin/destinations renders admin-destinations-table with 5 rows and scope badges; /admin/packages renders admin-packages-table with 6 rows; search 'osaka' narrows to 1 row, 'zzzzz' shows admin-packages-empty; filter admin-packages-filter-draft narrows to japan-sakura-preview; admin-package-new-button navigates to /admin/packages/new, editor loads with admin-package-title-input and admin-package-destination-select populated with all 5 destinations. Regression: /admin/dashboard and /api/public/destinations still 200. No defects found.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_packages.set_status validates images and inclusions presence but does NOT re-run the pydantic max_pax>=min_pax invariant on publish; if a package was created before that guard was in place it could publish in an inconsistent state. Not reproducible currently but worth adding as a defensive check.

admin_packages._normalise_children generates a new UUID whenever an incoming child lacks 'id', but the frontend PATCH sends the full array from state — deleted items are removed correctly, however if the same child is re-sent with its existing id it is left untouched (good). Consider adding a server-side dedupe on id to guard against a client bug submitting duplicate ids.

admin_destinations.delete_destination refuses when packages reference the destination but does not check if a booking is indirectly linked via package — acceptable since packages must be archived first, but the error copy could tell the admin to archive/delete the packages first (currently says 'Deactivate it instead' which refers to the destination, not the packages).

AdminPackagesPage's list query key is `['admin-packages', filters]` where filters contains `undefined` values — react-query will treat these as distinct cache entries from strings, so switching from 'all' to 'draft' back to 'all' works correctly, but if page pagination is added later, only-page changes will invalidate the whole cache. Minor caching opportunity.

AdminPackageEditorPage.save uses toast.success('Draft created') even when the API returns a 201 that could theoretically be a non-draft (backend hard-codes status=DRAFT so currently accurate, but the message is coupled to backend behavior).

Money fields (guest_price/agent_cost/commission_amount) accept the string '' from the form when the user clears them; pydantic will coerce '' to Decimal and raise 422 silently. The editor should show inline validation instead of relying on the API 422 which surfaces as a raw formatApiError string.

Public /api/public/packages filtering on published status is verified indirectly here — testing agent recommends adding a status='archived' item to the public suite once more archived packages exist to avoid regressions.
